title: 144. Valid Parenthesis String

examples.explanation: The characters in "(*)" can be arranged so all parentheses are properly matched.
The characters in "(*))" can be arranged so all parentheses are properly matched.

hints: Track a range of possible unmatched opening-parenthesis counts rather than choosing each star immediately.
An opening parenthesis increases both bounds; a closing parenthesis decreases both; a star can decrease the lower bound and increase the upper bound.
Clamp the lower bound at zero, reject if the upper bound becomes negative, and require the final lower bound to be zero.
